nom: Lancer Skincare Caviar Lime Acid Peel

segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin, including some who are sensitive/combination, describe the peel as well tolerated, with only mild, short-lived tingling and no burning, irritation, or breakouts even when left on longer than directed.
segments.dry: One reviewer with dry skin calls it an indispensable step in her routine, using treated pads through the week and a mask on Saturday nights.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin, including one who is also managing signs of aging, report it works well and gives noticeably renewed-looking skin.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their 50s report smoother, softer skin and reduced fine lines, sun damage and enlarged pores with regular use, describing results similar to a professional treatment.

concerns.aging: Reviewers report fewer fine lines and wrinkles and reduced visible sun damage with regular weekly use over months to years; several compare the results to an at-home light chemical peel or professional facial.
concerns.dehydration: Multiple reviewers describe skin as clean and hydrated rather than dried out immediately after use, with no reports of dryness or tightness from this acid peel.
concerns.spots: Reviewers report fading of dark spots and sun spots and a more even skin tone with continued use; one reviewer hoping it would fade a dark cheek patch had not yet confirmed results at the time of writing.
concerns.blemishes: Reviewers managing acne report drastically improved texture from past breakouts, reduced cystic acne, less congestion, and no new breakouts, including one who tolerates leaving the peel on for a full hour.

aspects.libelle: Skin feels noticeably softer and smoother after use
Small amount needed, lasts a long time

extraits.titre: Past texture issues from acne drastically improved
extraits.texte: I have used high end and low end and all in between. With the cleanser, polish and nourish and the caviar lime peel. My face is so refreshed and smooth. Also a redhead that can tan. No sensitivity to this peel. Nothing has ever compared to how great this works. Everyone notices and says how great my skin looks.

I love it! I noticed a difference within the first week. I love using the cleanser, and I sometimes use the polish as a spot treatment for active acne - it diminishes the size by a whole lot! I also noticed less cystic acne and less congestion. I added the caviar lime acid peel to use every other day - and my skin even tolerates it if I leave it on for 1 hour. It feels smooth and clean afterwards.

At first I did not know if I could use this product as I have sensitive/combination skin, but now I cannot live without it. I use once a week and apply to the tzone. It clears my skin of any residues. I leave on about 7-10 minutes and afterwards my skin feels so amazing. The scent is also unbelievable and I am VERY sensitive to any scents. This product is a must!

This product is like having a facial treatment at home. It even has a nice subtle citrus smell. I've noticed results of a smoother appearance to my skin as well as lightening of dark spots. The shipping is always on time and everything is packaged so well. I look forward to the treat of my "at home facial" during the week.

I was afraid to use it but now I can't be without it! I have enlarged pores and fine lines as a 54 yr old female but it install smooths my face and I was shocked! It really works! Not a fan of the smell but it's so worth it
Absolute favorite product! I have dry skin and can't live without this product! I use the pads through the week and a mask on Saturday nights.
This product works extremely well on combination skin as well as aging skin. Gives your skin new life!!
